prompt: Kavita always tells Seamus that (I / to update / my) notebook at night.
explanation_ru: Кавита говорит о себе, поэтому в косвенной речи I меняется на she, my — на her, а глагол после tells получает окончание -s (updates).

prompt: Tomasz told me on Tuesday he was tidying the loft (today).
explanation_ru: Разговор был во вторник, поэтому при передаче слов позже указатель времени today меняется на that day.

prompt: The coach explained that Chidi always stored his boots (here).
explanation_ru: В косвенной речи обстоятельство места here заменяется на there, если слова передаются уже в другом месте.

prompt: Our guest tells the hotel clerk that she locks ___ passport in the safe.
explanation_ru: Гостья говорит о своём паспорте (she), поэтому my из прямой речи переходит в her; частая ошибка — оставить my без изменения.

prompt: Lin texted from the pier that she was resting here until noon.
answer: Lin texted from the pier that she was resting there until noon.
accepted_answers: Lin texted from the pier that she was resting there until noon.
explanation_ru: Лин писала с пирса, а мы передаём её сообщение из другого места, поэтому here нужно заменить на there.

prompt: Omar often forgets his lunchbox. His classmates always tell him that (we / to share / our) sandwiches with (you).
explanation_ru: Одноклассники (they) обращаются к Омару (him), поэтому we переходит в they, our — в their, а you — в him.

prompt: Later, Fiona warned us she had not stored the paint ___ in the shed.
explanation_ru: При пересказе слов позже (Later) указатель места here меняется на there; частая ошибка — оставить here.

prompt: Rohan to me: “I can lend you my bike on Fridays.” → Rohan tells me …
answer: Rohan tells me that he can lend me his bike on Fridays.
accepted_answers: Rohan tells me that he can lend me his bike on Fridays.
Rohan tells me he can lend me his bike on Fridays.
explanation_ru: Рохан обращается ко мне, поэтому I становится he, you — me, а my — his; время после tells не сдвигается.

prompt: Kasia and Mateo visited the quiet park in April, and later told me about it. Kasia mentioned that local kids did not play (here) after dark. She showed me a photo of the wooden swings. Mateo added that the council had painted (these) benches blue in March. The neighbours also assured them that (our) children felt safe in the playground.
explanation_ru: Рассказ идёт уже не в парке, поэтому here меняется на there, а these — на those; слова соседей о своих детях требуют замены our на their.

prompt: Niamh tells Yusuf that (I / to trust / your) advice at work.
explanation_ru: Нив обращается к Юсуфу, поэтому I меняется на she, your — на his, а глагол в Present Simple получает -s (trusts).

prompt: Did Daisy mention that she had bought a new tent (yesterday), or did she borrow one from her cousin?
explanation_ru: При передаче речи в прошедшем времени (Did … mention … had bought) слово yesterday меняется на the day before или the previous day.

prompt: From the Bath pitch, Ravi told me, “We train here.” Back in London, how do I report this?
options: Ravi told me that we trained here.
Ravi told me that they trained there.
Ravi told me that they trained here.
Ravi told me that he trains there.
explanation_ru: Рави говорил о своей команде (we → they), а пересказ происходит уже в Лондоне (here → there), поэтому верен второй вариант.

prompt: Bartek stared at my short fringe in surprise. Still, he tells me that he really likes (your) new haircut.
explanation_ru: Бартек обращается ко мне (tells me), поэтому местоимение your из его слов относится ко мне и меняется на my.

prompt: A flat tyre stopped Tunde on Wednesday morning, so he phoned Carmen from the garage. He explained that he would not drive (my) van (tomorrow). Carmen offered to collect him after work instead. Tunde thanked her and promised to pay (you) back for the petrol. Before dusk, the mechanic had fixed the wheel.
explanation_ru: Тунде говорил о своём фургоне (my → his), обращаясь к Кармен (you → her), а tomorrow в пересказе меняется на the next day или the following day.

prompt: Sonia told us after the concert that she had not felt safe there because the street lights were broken.
answer: Sonia told us after the concert that she had not felt safe there because the street lights were broken.
accepted_answers: Sonia told us after the concert that she had not felt safe there because the street lights were broken.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: обстоятельство места here уже правильно заменено на there, а время сдвинуто в Past Perfect.

prompt: Two years after Mei left the shared flat, Gavin still reminds her that (we) once shared the same postcode.
explanation_ru: Гэвин и Мэй относятся к 3-му лицу для рассказчика, поэтому we из прямой речи переходит в they.

prompt: Layla called me while I was shopping for spices, and she explained that she was testing a curry sauce (now) and needed fresh ginger.
explanation_ru: Звонок уже в прошлом (called, was testing), поэтому слово now в косвенной речи меняется на then или at that moment.

prompt: Looking down, Neil complained to the waiter that (this) mug was cracked.
explanation_ru: В косвенной речи в прошедшем времени указательное местоимение this обычно заменяется на that.

prompt: Ananya saw my broken phone before the trip. She tells me that ___ can borrow ___ spare camera for the weekend.
explanation_ru: Ананья обращается ко мне (tells me), поэтому you меняется на I, а my (её камера) — на her; частая ошибка — оставить you или my.

prompt: Stuffy air filled the exam hall when Pawel walked in with Emeka. Later, Pawel told the caretaker that (this) hall badly needed fresh air. Did anyone unlock the high windows before the pupils arrived? Emeka added that the heat had given (us) a headache during the test. Afterwards, Pawel mentioned that the caretaker had finally shown (me) the fan switch.
explanation_ru: При пересказе позже this меняется на that, us (Павел и Эмека) — на them, а me (слова Павла о себе) — на him.

prompt: Lucia signed the rental contract in early June and called me with the news. She announced that she would move into the flat (next week). I offered to carry her boxes up the stairs. She laughed and told me that most of the furniture was not (mine), because the landlord was leaving a sofa and a table. She also explained that she (to paint) the bedroom pale green as soon as she got the keys.
explanation_ru: Next week переходит в the following week (или the next week), абсолютное притяжательное mine — в hers, а план на будущее после explained сдвигается в would paint.

prompt: Nobody claimed the green jacket on the gym bench, yet when I asked Wei about it later, he insisted ___ jacket belonged to ___ older sister.
explanation_ru: В пересказе позже нужно заменить и указательное слово (this → that), и притяжательное местоимение (my → his); частая ошибка — забыть сменить this.

prompt: Hasan's wooden garden gate had blown off its hinges in a storm. When we met in July, he proudly mentioned that he had mended the gate (last week). None of us believed he had done it without a carpenter. However, Hasan insisted that he had fixed all the boards by (myself). He also assured us that the latch (to hold) firmly through the next storm.
explanation_ru: Last week заменяется на the previous week (или the week before), возвратное местоимение myself — на himself, а will hold после assured сдвигается в would hold.

prompt: Having tested the spare office downstairs, the new intern told the manager this desk was far too low for his tall chair.
answer: Having tested the spare office downstairs, the new intern told the manager that desk was far too low for his tall chair.
accepted_answers: Having tested the spare office downstairs, the new intern told the manager that desk was far too low for his tall chair.
Having tested the spare office downstairs, the new intern told the manager that that desk was far too low for his tall chair.
explanation_ru: Стажёр сообщает о столе уже выйдя из запасного кабинета, поэтому в косвенной речи this нужно заменить на that.

prompt: Rainy mornings always caught the office clerk unprepared. His colleague teased him that he never reminded (yourself) to grab a coat before rushing out. Why did the hallway rack always hold three of his jackets? She pointed to a grey raincoat and asked if it was (yours). He laughed and promised he (not / to forget) his jacket on the rack again.
explanation_ru: Коллега обращалась к клерку (he), поэтому yourself меняется на himself, а yours — на his; обещание после promised требует сдвига will в wouldn't.

prompt: Sharing stories on the ferry, the elderly couple told us that they had moved to that coastal town three years (ago).
explanation_ru: В косвенной речи с Past Perfect слово ago не остаётся — его заменяют на before или earlier.

prompt: Pointing at a woven basket on her kitchen shelf, my neighbour told me, “I bought this basket at a street market.” How should I report her words later at home?
options: My neighbour told me that she had bought this basket at a street market.
My neighbour told me that I had bought that basket at a street market.
My neighbour told me that she had bought that basket at a street market.
My neighbour told me that she buys that basket at a street market.
explanation_ru: В пересказе дома нужно заменить I на she, this на that и сдвинуть Past Simple в Past Perfect (had bought); в остальных вариантах допущена одна из этих типичных ошибок.
